art_instructions: Create a sunny transition scene that shows the animals leaving the cozy cottage and walking along a gently curving stone-and-dirt path toward a small village school in the distance. On the far left background, include the family house with creamy wood siding, a warm terracotta roof, sage-green shutters, and the familiar yard tree plus sunflowers and lavender by the porch. On the far right background, show the whitewashed school with Mediterranean blue trim, terracotta roof tiles, an olive tree and a touch of bougainvillea near a low gate, plus a small stone bird bath by the entrance. In the foreground, the four friends walk rightward along the path, sized to fill the lower center third of the frame. Dinosaur leads slightly ahead, a pea‑green child-sized dino with a pale mint belly and small dorsal nubs, wearing a small red backpack; he points toward a wooden signpost that reads “σχολεῖον →” and looks eager. Panda walks just behind and to Dinosaur’s left, a round-faced cub with dark eye patches and black ear tufts, wearing a tiny acorn pouch on a strap; arms swing naturally and the expression is calm and curious. Koala walks beside Panda, small and gray with a leaf‑green scarf and an acorn‑brown backpack; she smiles gently and carries a small eucalyptus leaf in one paw. Owl glides low at kid eye level to their right, wings mid‑flap, green neck scarf and tiny satchel visible, head turned toward the children in a guiding, reassuring way. Keep the light bright with soft, clear shadows on the path, add a couple of butterflies and a robin along the hedges, and do not show any mice in this scene.
